{{Status infobox
|Immobilization
|A target affected by immobilization cannot perform any actions for the duration of this effect.
|type = Crowd Control
|source = Operator
}}
'''Immobilization''' is a crowd control status effect in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

When an enemy is affected is '''Immobilized''', they cannot perform any actions for the duration of this effect. Multiple sources of Immobilization <u>do not stack</u> additively and the target remains immobilized until the latest active immobilize effect expires.

After casting the skill, Si's battle skill is temporarily changed to {{Color|Final Stroke|7}}.<br />{{Color|Final Stroke|7}}: Costs no SP. Makes the {{Color|Inksoul|7}} disappear early.
